The machine works ONE territory at a time, in the order declared in `order`, and MAY NOT open the next until the current is SATURATED per method §0.8.6. Installed 2026-09-03 per PROPOSAL-2026-09-03-systematic-territory-model, on Chris's instruction: 'I want this machine to be systematic and methodical by going county by county across the United States.' UNIT IS THE STATE, not the county — CCR&Rs are multi-county lead agencies (Iowa is 5 employers across 99 counties), so a literal county walk would re-hit the same agency and break R1. Counties are kept as the SCOREBOARD (`counties_covered`/`counties_total`) so the county sentence survives; agencies remain the work.
_denominator_rule: 🔴 `lead_agencies_total` is null unless the machine READ that state's own CCR&R directory and COUNTED. An unenumerated territory has no denominator and must not invent one. `enumerated: false` forces §0.3 step 12b to enumerate before drafting.
